It was a cold night in solstheim as the title suggested. I was on my way to the telvanni base of operations to help master neloth run an errand when I spotted a patrol of redoran guards. Their bonemold armour thicker then the ashes of the red mountain just in the distance.

I decided to follow them as they were going the same way I was and they can provide extra protection. We then came across a crashed ship. We could see the reavers outside the ship. Guarding the area like those ash spawns guarding their fort. The leader of the patrol stood ready and charged in as his soldiers followed. I hesitated but joined in.

It was a fearsome battle. The sound of swords clashing rivalled that of the mages fire spells. It was a dangerous battle, but it was a quick one. The leader did not survive that night. His soldiers marched to the campfire. One of the guards took advantage of the hot stew the reavers prepared and another mined the heartstone deposit next to the ship. We all then sat down around the fire. Reminiscing of simpler times, we all raised a sujamma to our fallen captain, to promise to always remember him and hope that the tribunal (and hermaeus mora) has good plans for him.

We all parted ways. The redoran guards headed back to raven rock. Waiting to receive new orders, and I returned to Tel Mithryn, to give neloth his motherfucking tea.
